The articles are titled "The Whispering Tide," "The Cartography of Lost Islands," and "Midnight Drafting: How Fog, Tea, and Silence Shape the Narrative".


Initial construction of the `/stories/index.astro` hub page is underway, beginning with a replacement of the existing stub content.  The intention is to implement a dynamic query for all non-draft posts from the specified collection, sorting them by publication date in descending order. **Yes, absolutely.** We are still 100% built on top of **Scholar Pages** (`jxpeng98/astro-theme-scholars`, version 0.9.0).

Here is how the relationship works right now:

---

### 1. The Core Engine is Still Scholar Pages
All the underlying technical infrastructure running your site comes directly from `astro-theme-scholars`:
* **The Layout & Chrome:** [src/layouts/Layout.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/layouts/Layout.astro), the liquid-glass navigation header, the dark/light mode toggle, and the mobile responsive drawer.
* **The Performance Pipeline:** Astro 7.3, UnoCSS, Vite bundling, image optimization with Sharp, prefetching, and automated XML sitemaps.
* **SEO & Metadata:** Automated OpenGraph social preview cards, Twitter cards, and Schema.org structured data.
* **Test & Verification Suite:** The 15 Vitest test suites and the built-site assertion scripts ([scripts/assert-built-site.mjs](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/scripts/assert-built-site.mjs)).

---

### 2. Upstream Synchronisation Remains Protected
Your project still tracks `jxpeng98/astro-theme-scholars` as its upstream. 

In [.template-sync.json](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/.template-sync.json), all your custom author collections are strictly protected:
* `src/content/books/**`
* `src/content/series/**`
* `src/content/reviews/**`
* `src/content/announcements/**`
* `site.config.ts` and `.pages.yml`

This guarantees that if you ever pull upstream bug fixes or template updates from the original repository, your fiction author content and configurations will not be overwritten.

---

### 3. What We Are Adapting (The "Foundation, Not the Final Design" Rule)
Per your guiding rule in [PROJECT_CONTEXT.md](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md#L150-L152):
> *"Use Scholar Pages as a technical foundation, not as the final website design. Adapt the academic theme into a commercial fiction-author website."*

We are taking the robust academic machinery (which originally modeled *professors, syllabi, and research papers*) and repurposing its components into commercial fiction modules (*books, series universes, writing lore, and reader reviews*) without breaking the underlying theme architecture.

---

Artifacts are special markdown (.md) documents that you can create to present structured information to the user.
All artifacts should be written to the artifact directory: `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>`. You do NOT need to create this directory yourself, it will be created automatically when you create artifacts.

# When to Use Artifacts

**Use artifacts for:**
- Extensive reports and analysis summaries
- Persistent information you'll update over time (task lists, experiment logs)

**Don't use artifacts for:**
- Simple one-off answers or very short paragraph content - just respond directly
- Asking questions or requesting user input - just ask directly

**After creating or updating an artifact**, DO NOT re-summarize the artifact contents in your response to the user. Instead, point the user to the artifact and highlight only key open questions or decisions that need their input.


# Artifact Formatting Tips
When creating markdown artifacts, use standard markdown and GitHub Flavored Markdown formatting.

## Alerts
Use GitHub-style alerts strategically to emphasize critical information. Do not place consecutively or nest:
  > [!NOTE] Background context, implementation details, or explanations
  > [!TIP] Performance optimizations, best practices, or efficiency suggestions
  > [!IMPORTANT] Essential requirements, critical steps, or must-know information
  > [!WARNING] Breaking changes, compatibility issues, or potential problems
  > [!CAUTION] High-risk actions that could cause data loss or security vulnerabilities


## Mermaid Diagrams
Create mermaid diagrams using fenced code blocks with language `mermaid` to visualize relationships, workflows, and architectures.
- Only use supported diagram types:
  - Flowcharts / Graphs: `flowchart TD` / `flowchart LR` / `graph TD` / `graph LR`
  - Sequence Diagrams: `sequenceDiagram`
  - State Diagrams: `stateDiagram-v2` or `stateDiagram`
  - Class Diagrams: `classDiagram`
  - Entity-Relationship Diagrams: `erDiagram`
  - XY Charts: `xychart-beta`
- All other diagram types are unsupported. For schedules, timelines, or roadmaps, use directed flowcharts (`flowchart LR` / `flowchart TD`) or Markdown tables instead.
- To prevent syntax errors:
  - Quote node labels containing special characters like parentheses or brackets. For example, `id["Label (Extra Info)"]` instead of `id[Label (Extra Info)]`.
  - Avoid HTML tags in labels.

## File Links
- Link to line ranges using [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file#L123-L145) format.
- **IMPORTANT**: If you are embedding a file in an artifact and the file is NOT already in <appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>, you MUST first copy the file to the artifacts directory before embedding it. Only embed files that are located in the artifacts directory. Always use its absolute path `![caption](/absolute/path)`.
- **Use basenames for readability**: Use file basenames for the link text instead of the full path

## Carousels
Use ````carousel syntax with `<!-- slide -->` HTML comments to display related markdown snippets sequentially (before/after comparisons, UI progressions, alternative approaches, walkthroughs). Four backticks enable nesting code blocks within slides.

Example:
````carousel
![Image description](/absolute/path/to/image1.png)
<!-- slide -->
```python
def example():
    print("Code in carousel")
```
````

## LaTeX / Math

- **Literal `$`**: escape it as `\$` in prose (\$100), or write it bare inside backticks (`$HOME`)

- Temporary data files and intermediate outputs

# File Format
Transcripts are in JSON Lines (JSONL) format. Each line is a single JSON object representing one "step" or action in the conversation.
Each JSON object contains fields such as:
- `step_index`: The index of the step in the trajectory.
- `source`: The source of the action (e.g., `USER_EXPLICIT`, `MODEL`, `SYSTEM`).
- `type`: The type of the step. Particular steps of interest are `USER_INPUT`, which represents a user's prompt, and `PLANNER_RESPONSE`, which represents the agent's response and tool calls.
- `status`: The status of the step (e.g., `DONE`, `ERROR`).
- `created_at`: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the step occurred.
- `content`: The text content of the step (e.g., the user's request, the model's response, or tool responses).
- `thinking`: The model's internal reasoning / chain-of-thought (for `PLANNER_RESPONSE` steps).
- `tool_calls`: An array of tool calls made in this step, including their arguments.
- `media`: An array of media (e.g. images) attached to the step, each with a `mime_type` and a `uri` referencing the media file on disk. Media bytes are not stored in the transcript; view the `uri` path to see the media.
- `truncated_fields`: An array of field names that were truncated (e.g., `["content"]`, `["thinking"]`, `["tool_calls"]`). Only present in `transcript.jsonl` when truncation occurred (never in `transcript_full.jsonl`). When present, read the corresponding line in `transcript_full.jsonl` for the complete content.

/Here is the plan to build the **Individual Book Detail Pages (`/books/[...slug]`)**.

In accordance with your rules, this is a **read-only proposal for your review**. No files will be modified and no commands will be run until you explicitly say **"Apply these changes"**.

---

### Three Strategic Perspectives

* **Developer Perspective:**  
  Astro handles dynamic content pages using the `[...slug].astro` naming convention. In [src/pages/books/[...slug].astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/books/[...slug].astro), the `getStaticPaths()` function queries `getCollection("books")` and pre-renders an individual static HTML page for every title in your collection (`/books/the-whispering-tide`, `/books/shadows-of-the-sunken-spire`, `/books/the-clockwork-cartographer`). We adapt the architectural patterns from [DetailShell.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/components/DetailShell.astro) (breadcrumb navigation, sticky metadata sidebar, responsive grid), customized for fiction publishing:
  * Vertical **2:3 portrait book cover framing** (rather than a 16:9 banner).
  * Prominent **multi-retailer purchase buttons** and **sample download links**.
  * Dynamic cross-collection query linking **parent series** and **approved reader reviews** for that specific book.

* **Entrepreneur Perspective:**  
  The individual book page is the primary point of conversion in the **Action Stage** of the Attention 

---

 Return pipeline. When a reader clicks through from social media, a newsletter, or the catalog, this page eliminates all hesitation:
  1. Hooks them with the book's emotional premise and central conflict.
  2. Offers an immediate zero-friction sample read (*"Download Chapter 1"*).
  3. Displays direct retailer options so they can buy in their preferred format (*Kindle, Audible, Paperback, Hardcover*).
  4. Provides social proof via approved reader reviews.

* **Learning Perspective:**  
  You will see how Astro handles **dynamic static generation**. When you create a new Markdown file in `src/content/books/my-new-novel.md`, Astro automatically generates a new URL route `/books/my-new-novel` with full SEO tags and canonical links at build time, with zero manual routing code.

---

### Proposed Implementation Details

#### 1. Add Approved Sample Reviews: `src/content/reviews/`
To verify that connected book reviews display properly, we create two sample reviews matching `src/content.config.ts`:

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-1.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: An atmospheric triumph. Padasian captures the eerie beauty of the shoreline and the suffocating weight of family secrets with astonishing prose.
reviewerName: Historical Fiction Review
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: true
draft: false
---
```

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-2.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: I devoured this in two sittings. Maeve Gallagher is the kind of flawed, determined protagonist you cannot help but champion.
reviewerName: Verified Reader
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: false
draft: false
---
```

---

#### 2. Create `src/pages/books/[...slug].astro`
This page generates the dynamic book details, links back to the catalog, renders Markdown synopses, and displays retail modules and approved reviews:

```astro
---
import { getCollection, render, getEntry, type CollectionEntry } from "astro:content";
import Layout from "../../layouts/Layout.astro";

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const books = await getCollection("books", ({ data }) => !data.draft);
  return books.map((book) => ({
    params: { slug: book.id },
    props: { book },
  }));
}

const { book } = Astro.props as { book: CollectionEntry<"books"> };
const { Content } = await render(book);
const { data } = book;

// Cross-collection queries
const series = data.seriesSlug ? await getEntry("series", data.seriesSlug) : null;
const reviews = await getCollection("reviews", ({ data: rev }) => 
  rev.approved && !rev.draft && rev.bookSlug === book.id
);
---

<Layout
  title={`${data.title} | Books`}
  description={data.description}
  image={data.cover?.src}
  imageAlt={data.coverAlt}
>
  <article class="page-stack space-y-8 sm:space-y-10">
    <!-- Back to Catalog Link -->
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <a href="/books" class="action-link inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm px-0">
        <span class="i-mdi:arrow-left" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>Back to Books Showcase</span>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-7 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
      {series && (
        <p class="font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
          {series.data.title} {data.seriesOrder && `

---

 Book ${data.seriesOrder}`}
        </p>
      )}
      <h1 class="page-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-5xl">
        {data.title}
      </h1>
      {data.tagline && (
        <p class="text-xl italic font-medium text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
          "{data.tagline}"
        </p>
      )}
    </header>

    <!-- Two-Column Layout: Main Story & Aside Details -->
    <div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] lg:items-start lg:gap-12">
      <!-- Main Content Column -->
      <div class="min-w-0 space-y-8">
        <!-- Official Synopsis -->
        <section class="space-y-4" aria-labelledby="synopsis-heading">
          <h2 id="synopsis-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            About the Story
          </h2>
          <p class="text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
            {data.description}
          </p>
        </section>

        <!-- Long-form Markdown Content -->
        <div class="prose max-w-none text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300 border-t border-paper-300/80 pt-6 dark:border-ink-700">
          <Content />
        </div>

	The dynamic route setup uses `getStaticPaths()` to generate static paths for book pages. The code iterates through non-draft book entries to create routes based on their IDs, passing the book data as props. This approach suggests a static site generation strategy where each book's page is pre-rendered during the build process.


Initial rendering involves using a `render()` function to generate the book content. Linked series information and reader reviews are fetched using `getEntry()` and `getCollection()` respectively. The goal is to adapt an existing component (`DetailShell.astro`) for book pages, considering the need for a portrait-oriented cover and book-specific details like purchase links and review integration. The current page `/src/pages/books/[...slug].astro` will be checked to determine if a dedicated component is required.

Previously noted there were no review files; sample reviews will be created and connected to a book slug for display, enabling the reader reviews section to showcase social proof.

  You will see how Astro handles **dynamic static generation**. When you create a new Markdown file in `src/content/books/my-new-novel.md`, Astro automatically generates a new URL route `/books/my-new-novel` with full SEO tags and canonical links at build time, with zero manual routing code.

---

### Proposed Implementation Details

#### 1. Add Approved Sample Reviews: `src/content/reviews/`
To verify that connected book reviews display properly, we create two sample reviews matching `src/content.config.ts`:

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-1.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: An atmospheric triumph. Padasian captures the eerie beauty of the shoreline and the suffocating weight of family secrets with astonishing prose.
reviewerName: Historical Fiction Review
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: true
draft: false
---
```

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-2.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: I devoured this in two sittings. Maeve Gallagher is the kind of flawed, determined protagonist you cannot help but champion.
reviewerName: Verified Reader
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: false
draft: false
---
```

---

#### 2. Create `src/pages/books/[...slug].astro`
This page generates the dynamic book details, links back to the catalog, renders Markdown synopses, and displays retail modules and approved reviews:

```astro
---
import { getCollection, render, getEntry, type CollectionEntry } from "astro:content";
import Layout from "../../layouts/Layout.astro";

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const books = await getCollection("books", ({ data }) => !data.draft);
  return books.map((book) => ({
    params: { slug: book.id },
    props: { book },
  }));
}

const { book } = Astro.props as { book: CollectionEntry<"books"> };
const { Content } = await render(book);
const { data } = book;

// Cross-collection queries
const series = data.seriesSlug ? await getEntry("series", data.seriesSlug) : null;
const reviews = await getCollection("reviews", ({ data: rev }) => 
  rev.approved && !rev.draft && rev.bookSlug === book.id
);
---

<Layout
  title={`${data.title} | Books`}
  description={data.description}
  image={data.cover?.src}
  imageAlt={data.coverAlt}
>
  <article class="page-stack space-y-8 sm:space-y-10">
    <!-- Back to Catalog Link -->
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <a href="/books" class="action-link inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm px-0">
        <span class="i-mdi:arrow-left" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>Back to Books Showcase</span>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-7 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
      {series && (
        <p class="font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
          {series.data.title} {data.seriesOrder && `

---

 Book ${data.seriesOrder}`}
        </p>
      )}
      <h1 class="page-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-5xl">
        {data.title}
      </h1>
      {data.tagline && (
        <p class="text-xl italic font-medium text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
          "{data.tagline}"
        </p>
      )}
    </header>

    <!-- Two-Column Layout: Main Story & Aside Details -->
    <div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] lg:items-start lg:gap-12">
      <!-- Main Content Column -->
      <div class="min-w-0 space-y-8">
        <!-- Official Synopsis -->
        <section class="space-y-4" aria-labelledby="synopsis-heading">
          <h2 id="synopsis-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            About the Story
          </h2>
          <p class="text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
            {data.description}
          </p>
        </section>

        <!-- Long-form Markdown Content -->
        <div class="prose max-w-none text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300 border-t border-paper-300/80 pt-6 dark:border-ink-700">
          <Content />
        </div>

_Here is the plan to build the **Individual Book Detail Pages (`/books/[...slug]`)**.

In accordance with your rules, this is a **read-only proposal for your review**. No files will be modified and no commands will be run until you explicitly say **"Apply these changes"**.

---

### Three Strategic Perspectives

* **Developer Perspective:**  
  Astro handles dynamic content pages using the `[...slug].astro` naming convention. In [src/pages/books/[...slug].astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/books/[...slug].astro), the `getStaticPaths()` function queries `getCollection("books")` and pre-renders an individual static HTML page for every title in your collection (`/books/the-whispering-tide`, `/books/shadows-of-the-sunken-spire`, `/books/the-clockwork-cartographer`). We adapt the architectural patterns from [DetailShell.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/components/DetailShell.astro) (breadcrumb navigation, sticky metadata sidebar, responsive grid), customized for fiction publishing:
  * Vertical **2:3 portrait book cover framing** (rather than a 16:9 banner).
  * Prominent **multi-retailer purchase buttons** and **sample download links**.
  * Dynamic cross-collection query linking **parent series** and **approved reader reviews** for that specific book.

* **Entrepreneur Perspective:**  
  The individual book page is the primary point of conversion in the **Action Stage** of the Attention 

---

 Return pipeline. When a reader clicks through from social media, a newsletter, or the catalog, this page eliminates all hesitation:
  1. Hooks them with the book's emotional premise and central conflict.
  2. Offers an immediate zero-friction sample read (*"Download Chapter 1"*).
  3. Displays direct retailer options so they can buy in their preferred format (*Kindle, Audible, Paperback, Hardcover*).
  4. Provides social proof via approved reader reviews.

* **Learning Perspective:**  
  You will see how Astro handles **dynamic static generation**. When you create a new Markdown file in `src/content/books/my-new-novel.md`, Astro automatically generates a new URL route `/books/my-new-novel` with full SEO tags and canonical links at build time, with zero manual routing code.

### Proposed Implementation Details

#### 1. Add Approved Sample Reviews: `src/content/reviews/`
To verify that connected book reviews display properly, we create two sample reviews matching `src/content.config.ts`:

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-1.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: An atmospheric triumph. Padasian captures the eerie beauty of the shoreline and the suffocating weight of family secrets with astonishing prose.
reviewerName: Historical Fiction Review
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: true
draft: false
---
```

* **`src/content/reviews/whispering-tide-review-2.md`**:
```markdown
---
quote: I devoured this in two sittings. Maeve Gallagher is the kind of flawed, determined protagonist you cannot help but champion.
reviewerName: Verified Reader
bookSlug: the-whispering-tide
approved: true
featured: false
draft: false
---
```

---

#### 2. Create `src/pages/books/[...slug].astro`
This page generates the dynamic book details, links back to the catalog, renders Markdown synopses, and displays retail modules and approved reviews:

```astro
---
import { getCollection, render, getEntry, type CollectionEntry } from "astro:content";
import Layout from "../../layouts/Layout.astro";

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const books = await getCollection("books", ({ data }) => !data.draft);
  return books.map((book) => ({
    params: { slug: book.id },
    props: { book },
  }));
}

const { book } = Astro.props as { book: CollectionEntry<"books"> };
const { Content } = await render(book);
const { data } = book;

// Cross-collection queries
const series = data.seriesSlug ? await getEntry("series", data.seriesSlug) : null;
const reviews = await getCollection("reviews", ({ data: rev }) => 
  rev.approved && !rev.draft && rev.bookSlug === book.id
);
---

<Layout
  title={`${data.title} | Books`}
  description={data.description}
  image={data.cover?.src}
  imageAlt={data.coverAlt}
>
  <article class="page-stack space-y-8 sm:space-y-10">
    <!-- Back to Catalog Link -->
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <a href="/books" class="action-link inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm px-0">
        <span class="i-mdi:arrow-left" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>Back to Books Showcase</span>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-7 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
      {series && (
        <p class="font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
          {series.data.title} {data.seriesOrder && `

---

 Book ${data.seriesOrder}`}
        </p>
      )}
      <h1 class="page-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-5xl">
        {data.title}
      </h1>
      {data.tagline && (
        <p class="text-xl italic font-medium text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
          "{data.tagline}"
        </p>
      )}
    </header>

    <!-- Two-Column Layout: Main Story & Aside Details -->
    <div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] lg:items-start lg:gap-12">
      <!-- Main Content Column -->
      <div class="min-w-0 space-y-8">
        <!-- Official Synopsis -->
        <section class="space-y-4" aria-labelledby="synopsis-heading">
          <h2 id="synopsis-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            About the Story
          </h2>
          <p class="text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
            {data.description}
          </p>
        </section>

        <!-- Long-form Markdown Content -->
        <div class="prose max-w-none text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300 border-t border-paper-300/80 pt-6 dark:border-ink-700">
          <Content />
        </div>

        <!-- Approved Reader Reviews Module -->
        {reviews.length > 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="reviews-heading" class="border-t border-paper-300/90 pt-8 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-4">
            <h2 id="reviews-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
              Reader Praise & Reactions
            </h2>
            <div class="grid gap-4">
              {reviews.map((rev) => (
                <blockquote class="surface-card rounded-xl border border-paper-300/80 p-5 dark:border-ink-700">
                  <p class="text-base italic text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
                    "{rev.data.quote}"
                  </p>
                  {rev.data.reviewerName && (
                    <footer class="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
                      

---

 {rev.data.reviewerName}
                    </footer>
                  )}
                </blockquote>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>

      <!-- Sticky Sidebar: Cover & Buy Modules -->
      <aside class="space-y-6 lg:sticky lg:top-24" aria-label="Book purchase and formats">
        <!-- Book Cover Art Frame -->
        <div class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-paper-100/80 p-6 dark:bg-ink-900/60 border border-paper-300/80 dark:border-ink-800">
          <div class="aspect-[2/3] w-48 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-accent-700 to-accent-950 p-4 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between text-white text-center">
            <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-accent-200">Alis Padasian</span>
            <h3 class="font-serif text-lg font-bold leading-tight">{data.title}</h3>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-accent-300">A Novel</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sample Download CTA -->
        {data.sampleLink && (
          <a
            href={data.sampleLink.href}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            class="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-accent-700 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent-800 dark:bg-accent-600 dark:hover:bg-accent-500 no-underline text-center"
          >
            <span class="i-mdi:book-open-page-variant text-base" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{data.sampleLink.label}</span>
          </a>
        )}

        <!-- Retailer Buy Links -->
        {data.purchaseLinks.length > 0 && (
          <div class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
            <h3 class="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100">
              Get Your Copy
            </h3>
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {data.purchaseLinks.map((link) => (
                <a
                  href={link.href}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  class="action-link flex min-h-10 items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/70 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-100"
                >
                  <span>{link.label}</span>
                  <span class="i-mdi:open-in-new text-xs" aria-hidden="true" />
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <!-- Quick Facts / Metadata -->
        <div class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3 text-xs">
          <h3 class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100">
            Book Details
          </h3>
          <dl class="space-y-2">
            <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
              <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Status</dt>
              <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">{data.status}</dd>
            </div>
            {data.formats.length > 0 && (
              <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Formats</dt>
                <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">
                  {data.formats.join(", ")}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
            {data.genres.length > 0 && (
              <div class="pt-1">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400 mb-1.5">Genres</dt>
                <dd class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {data.genres.map((g) => (
                    <span class="rounded bg-paper-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-300">
                      {g}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </article>
</Layout>
```

              {data.purchaseLinks.map((link) => (
                <a
                  href={link.href}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  class="action-link flex min-h-10 items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/70 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-100"
                >
                  <span>{link.label}</span>
                  <span class="i-mdi:open-in-new text-xs" aria-hidden="true" />
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <!-- Quick Facts / Metadata -->
        <div class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3 text-xs">
          <h3 class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100">
            Book Details
          </h3>
          <dl class="space-y-2">
            <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
              <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Status</dt>
              <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">{data.status}</dd>
            </div>
            {data.formats.length > 0 && (
              <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Formats</dt>
                <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">
                  {data.formats.join(", ")}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
            {data.genres.length > 0 && (
              <div class="pt-1">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400 mb-1.5">Genres</dt>
                <dd class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {data.genres.map((g) => (
                    <span class="rounded bg-paper-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-300">
                      {g}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </article>
</Layout>
```

!data.draft)).sort(\n  (a, b) =\u003e {\n    const dateA = a.data.publicationDate ? new Date(a.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;\n    const dateB = b.data.publicationDate ? new Date(b.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;\n    return dateB - dateA;\n  }\n);\n\nconst allSeries = await getCollection(\"series\", ({ data }) =\u003e !data.draft);\nconst seriesMap = new Y---
import Layout from "../../layouts/Layout.astro";
import { getCollection } from "astro:content";

const allBooks = (await getCollection("books", ({ data }) => !data.draft)).sort(
  (a, b) => {
    const dateA = a.data.publicationDate ? new Date(a.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;
    const dateB = b.data.publicationDate ? new Date(b.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;
    return dateB - dateA;
  }
);

const allSeries = await getCollection("series", ({ data }) => !data.draft);
const seriesMap = new Map(allSeries.map((s) => [s.id, s.data.title]));

const featuredBook = allBooks.find((b) => b.data.featured) ?? allBooks[0];
const catalogBooks = allBooks.filter((b) => b.id !== featuredBook?.id);
---

<Layout
  title="Books Showcase"
  description="Explore the fictional worlds, novels, and standalone stories by Alis Padasian."
>
  <div class="page-stack space-y-10 sm:space-y-12">
    <!-- Header -->
    <header class="page-header border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-6 dark:border-ink-700">
      <h1 class="page-title text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-5xl">
        The Books Showcase
      </h1>
      <p class="page-description mt-3 max-w-2xl text-lg text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
        Step into evocative worlds of secrets, fog-shrouded mysteries, and character-driven adventures.
      </p>
    </header>

    <!-- Lead / Gateway Book Feature (Hero Swap & Action) -->
    {featuredBook && (
      <section aria-labelledby="featured-book-heading" class="content-section">
        <div class="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-accent-300/60 bg-accent-50/70 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-accent-800 dark:border-accent-700/50 dark:bg-accent-950/40 dark:text-accent-200">
            <span class="i-mdi:star text-xs" aria-hidden="true" />
            Recommended Gateway Title
          </span>
          {featuredBook.data.status === "forthcoming" && (
            <span class="rounded-md border border-amber-300/70 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800 dark:border-amber-700/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300">
              Coming Soon
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <article class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-ink-700 sm:p-8">
          <div class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
            <div class="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
              {featuredBook.data.seriesSlug && (
                <p class="font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
                  {seriesMap.get(featuredBook.data.seriesSlug) ?? featuredBook.data.seriesSlug}
                  {featuredBook.data.seriesOrder && ` 

---

 Book ${featuredBook.data.seriesOrder}`}
                </p>
              )}

              <h2 id="featured-book-heading" class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-4xl">
                <a href={`/books/${featuredBook.id}`} class="hover:text-accent-700 dark:hover:text-accent-300 transition-colors no-underline text-inherit">
                  {featuredBook.data.title}
                </a>
              </h2>

              {featuredBook.data.tagline && (
                <p class="text-lg italic font-medium text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
                  "{featuredBook.data.tagline}"
                </p>
              )}

              <p class="text-base leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
                {featuredBook.data.description}
              </p>

              <!-- Genre badges -->
              {featuredBook.data.genres.length > 0 && (
                <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-2">
                  {featuredBook.data.genres.map((genre) => (
                    <span class="rounded-md border border-paper-300/80 bg-paper-100/70 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-ink-700 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800/60 dark:text-paper-300">
                      {genre}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <!-- Available Formats -->
              {featuredBook.data.formats.length > 0 && (
                <div class="pt-2 text-xs text-ink-600 dark:text-paper-400">
                  <span class="font-semibold text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">Available Formats:</span>{" "}
                  {featuredBook.data.formats.map((f) => f.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + f.slice(1)).join(" 

---

 ")}
                </div>
              )}

              <!-- Action CTAs: Sample, Purchase Links, Details -->
              <div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-paper-200 dark:border-ink-800">
                <a
                  href={`/books/${featuredBook.id}`}
                  class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-accent-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-800 dark:bg-accent-600 dark:hover:bg-accent-500 no-underline"
                >
                  <span>Book Details</span>
                  <span class="i-mdi:arrow-right text-base" aria-hidden="true" />
                </a>

                {featuredBook.data.sampleLink && (
                  <a
                    href={featuredBook.data.sampleLink.href}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    class="action-link inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/60 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800/50 dark:text-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-ink-700"
                  >
                    <span class="i-mdi:book-open-page-variant text-sm" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <span>{featuredBook.data.sampleLink.label}</span>
                  </a>
                )}

                {featuredBook.data.purchaseLinks.map((link) => (
                  <a
                    href={link.href}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    class="action-link inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/60 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800/50 dark:text-paper-100 dark:hover:bg-ink-700"
                  >
                    <span>{link.label}</span>
                    <span class="i-mdi:open-in-new text-xs" aria-hidden="true" />
                  </a>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Visual Cover Frame with link -->
            <a href={`/books/${featuredBook.id}`} class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-paper-100/60 p-6 dark:bg-ink-900/60 border border-paper-300/80 dark:border-ink-800 no-underline group">
              <div class="aspect-[2/3] w-48 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-accent-700 to-accent-950 p-4 shadow-md flex flex-col justify-between text-white text-center transition-transform group-hover:scale-105">
                <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-accent-200">Alis Padasian</span>
                <h3 class="font-serif text-lg font-bold leading-tight">{featuredBook.data.title}</h3>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-accent-300">View Details &rarr;</span>
              </div>
            </a>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>
    )}

    <!-- Complete Catalog Grid -->
    {catalogBooks.length > 0 && (
      <section aria-labelledby="catalog-heading" class="content-section space-y-6">
        <h2 id="catalog-heading" class="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
          More Titles in the Catalog
        </h2>

        <div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
          {catalogBooks.map((book) => (
            <article class="surface-card flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl border border-paper-300/90 p-6 dark:border-ink-700">
              <div class="space-y-3">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  {book.data.seriesSlug ? (
                    <span class="font-mono text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300 font-semibold">
                      {seriesMap.get(book.data.seriesSlug) ?? book.data.seriesSlug}
                      {book.data.seriesOrder && ` 

---

 #${book.data.seriesOrder}`}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span class="font-mono text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Standalone</span>
                  )}
                  {book.data.status === "forthcoming" && (
                    <span class="rounded bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-medium text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 text-[11px]">
                      Forthcoming
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
                  <a href={`/books/${book.id}`} class="hover:text-accent-700 dark:hover:text-accent-300 transition-colors no-underline text-inherit">
                    {book.data.title}
                  </a>
                </h3>

                {book.data.tagline && (
                  <p class="text-sm italic text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
                    "{book.data.tagline}"
                  </p>
                )}

                <p class="text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-600 dark:text-paper-300 line-clamp-3">
                  {book.data.description}
                </p>

                {book.data.genres.length > 0 && (
                  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pt-1">
                    {book.data.genres.map((genre) => (
                      <span class="rounded border border-paper-300/80 bg-paper-100/50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-700 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800/50 dark:text-paper-300">
                        {genre}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <!-- Retailer Links / Details CTA -->
              <div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-paper-200/90 dark:border-ink-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <a
                  href={`/books/${book.id}`}
                  class="font-semibold text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300 hover:underline"
                >
                  View Details &rarr;
                </a>

                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {book.data.purchaseLinks.slice(0, 2).map((link) => (
                    <a
                      href={link.href}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      class="rounded border border-paper-300 bg-white/70 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-ink-800 hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200 dark:hover:bg-ink-700 no-underline"
                    >
                      {link.label}
                    </a>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    )}
  </div>
</Layout>

!data.draft)).sort(\n  (a, b) =\u003e {\n    const dateA = a.data.publicationDate ? new Date(a.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;\n    const dateB = b.data.publicationDate ? new Date(b.data.publicationDate).getTime() : 0;\n    return dateB - dateA;\n  }\n);\n\nconst allSeries = await getCollection(\"series\", ({ data }) =\u003e !data.draft);\nconst seriesMap = new =---
import { getCollection, render, getEntry, type CollectionEntry } from "astro:content";
import Layout from "../../layouts/Layout.astro";

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const books = await getCollection("books", ({ data }) => !data.draft);
  return books.map((book) => ({
    params: { slug: book.id },
    props: { book },
  }));
}

const { book } = Astro.props as { book: CollectionEntry<"books"> };
const { Content } = await render(book);
const { data } = book;

// Cross-collection queries
const series = data.seriesSlug ? await getEntry("series", data.seriesSlug) : null;
const reviews = await getCollection("reviews", ({ data: rev }) => 
  rev.approved && !rev.draft && rev.bookSlug === book.id
);
---

<Layout
  title={`${data.title} | Books`}
  description={data.description}
  image={data.cover?.src}
  imageAlt={data.coverAlt}
>
  <article class="page-stack space-y-8 sm:space-y-10">
    <!-- Back to Catalog Link -->
    <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
      <a href="/books" class="action-link inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm px-0">
        <span class="i-mdi:arrow-left" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span>Back to Books Showcase</span>
      </a>
    </nav>

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-7 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
      {series && (
        <p class="font-mono text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
          {series.data.title} {data.seriesOrder && `

---

 Book ${data.seriesOrder}`}
        </p>
      )}
      <h1 class="page-title text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50 sm:text-5xl">
        {data.title}
      </h1>
      {data.tagline && (
        <p class="text-xl italic font-medium text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
          "{data.tagline}"
        </p>
      )}
    </header>

    <!-- Two-Column Layout: Main Story & Aside Details -->
    <div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem] lg:items-start lg:gap-12">
      <!-- Main Content Column -->
      <div class="min-w-0 space-y-8">
        <!-- Official Synopsis -->
        <section class="space-y-4" aria-labelledby="synopsis-heading">
          <h2 id="synopsis-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            About the Story
          </h2>
          <p class="text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
            {data.description}
          </p>
        </section>

        <!-- Long-form Markdown Content -->
        <div class="prose max-w-none text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300 border-t border-paper-300/80 pt-6 dark:border-ink-700">
          <Content />
        </div>

        <!-- Approved Reader Reviews Module -->
        {reviews.length > 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="reviews-heading" class="border-t border-paper-300/90 pt-8 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-4">
            <h2 id="reviews-heading" class="text-xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
              Reader Praise & Reactions
            </h2>
            <div class="grid gap-4">
              {reviews.map((rev) => (
                <blockquote class="surface-card rounded-xl border border-paper-300/80 p-5 dark:border-ink-700">
                  <p class="text-base italic text-ink-800 dark:text-paper-200">
                    "{rev.data.quote}"
                  </p>
                  {rev.data.reviewerName && (
                    <footer class="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-accent-700 dark:text-accent-300">
                      

---

 {rev.data.reviewerName}
                    </footer>
                  )}
                </blockquote>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>

      <!-- Sticky Sidebar: Cover & Buy Modules -->
      <aside class="space-y-6 lg:sticky lg:top-24" aria-label="Book purchase and formats">
        <!-- Book Cover Art Frame -->
        <div class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-paper-100/80 p-6 dark:bg-ink-900/60 border border-paper-300/80 dark:border-ink-800">
          <div class="aspect-[2/3] w-48 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-accent-700 to-accent-950 p-4 shadow-lg flex flex-col justify-between text-white text-center">
            <span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-accent-200">Alis Padasian</span>
            <h3 class="font-serif text-lg font-bold leading-tight">{data.title}</h3>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-accent-300">A Novel</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Sample Download CTA -->
        {data.sampleLink && (
          <a
            href={data.sampleLink.href}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            class="flex min-h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-accent-700 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent-800 dark:bg-accent-600 dark:hover:bg-accent-500 no-underline text-center"
          >
            <span class="i-mdi:book-open-page-variant text-base" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span>{data.sampleLink.label}</span>
          </a>
        )}

        <!-- Retailer Buy Links -->
        {data.purchaseLinks.length > 0 && (
          <div class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3">
            <h3 class="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100">
              Get Your Copy
            </h3>
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
              {data.purchaseLinks.map((link) => (
                <a
                  href={link.href}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  class="action-link flex min-h-10 items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/70 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-100"
                >
                  <span>{link.label}</span>
                  <span class="i-mdi:open-in-new text-xs" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <!-- Quick Facts / Metadata -->
        <div class="surface-card rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-3 text-xs">
          <h3 class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100">
            Book Details
          </h3>
          <dl class="space-y-2">
            <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
              <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Status</dt>
              <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">{data.status}</dd>
            </div>
            {data.formats.length > 0 && (
              <div class="flex justify-between border-b border-paper-200 pb-1.5 dark:border-ink-800">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400">Formats</dt>
                <dd class="font-semibold text-ink-900 dark:text-paper-100 capitalize">
                  {data.formats.join(", ")}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
            {data.genres.length > 0 && (
              <div class="pt-1">
                <dt class="text-ink-500 dark:text-paper-400 mb-1.5">Genres</dt>
                <dd class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {data.genres.map((g) => (
                    <span class="rounded bg-paper-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-800 dark:text-paper-300">
                      {g}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </dd>
              </div>
            )}
          </dl>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </article>
</Layout>

<artifacts>
Artifacts are special markdown (.md) documents that you can create to present structured information to the user.
All artifacts should be written to the artifact directory: `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>`. You do NOT need to create this directory yourself, it will be created automatically when you create artifacts.

# When to Use Artifacts

**Use artifacts for:**
- Extensive reports and analysis summaries
- Persistent information you'll update over time (task lists, experiment logs)

**Don't use artifacts for:**
- Simple one-off answers or very short paragraph content - just respond directly
- Asking questions or requesting user input - just ask directly

**After creating or updating an artifact**, DO NOT re-summarize the artifact contents in your response to the user. Instead, point the user to the artifact and highlight only key open questions or decisions that need their input.


# Artifact Formatting Tips
When creating markdown artifacts, use standard markdown and GitHub Flavored Markdown formatting.

## Alerts
Use GitHub-style alerts strategically to emphasize critical information. Do not place consecutively or nest:
  > [!NOTE] Background context, implementation details, or explanations
  > [!TIP] Performance optimizations, best practices, or efficiency suggestions
  > [!IMPORTANT] Essential requirements, critical steps, or must-know information
  > [!WARNING] Breaking changes, compatibility issues, or potential problems
  > [!CAUTION] High-risk actions that could cause data loss or security vulnerabilities


## Mermaid Diagrams
Create mermaid diagrams using fenced code blocks with language `mermaid` to visualize relationships, workflows, and architectures.
- Only use supported diagram types:
  - Flowcharts / Graphs: `flowchart TD` / `flowchart LR` / `graph TD` / `graph LR`
  - Sequence Diagrams: `sequenceDiagram`
  - State Diagrams: `stateDiagram-v2` or `stateDiagram`
  - Class Diagrams: `classDiagram`
  - Entity-Relationship Diagrams: `erDiagram`
  - XY Charts: `xychart-beta`
- All other diagram types are unsupported. For schedules, timelines, or roadmaps, use directed flowcharts (`flowchart LR` / `flowchart TD`) or Markdown tables instead.
- To prevent syntax errors:
  - Quote node labels containing special characters like parentheses or brackets. For example, `id["Label (Extra Info)"]` instead of `id[Label (Extra Info)]`.
  - Avoid HTML tags in labels.

## File Links
- Link to line ranges using [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file#L123-L145) format.
- **IMPORTANT**: If you are embedding a file in an artifact and the file is NOT already in <appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>, you MUST first copy the file to the artifacts directory before embedding it. Only embed files that are located in the artifacts directory. Always use its absolute path `![caption](/absolute/path)`.
- **Use basenames for readability**: Use file basenames for the link text instead of the full path

## Carousels
Use ````carousel syntax with `<!-- slide -->` HTML comments to display related markdown snippets sequentially (before/after comparisons, UI progressions, alternative approaches, walkthroughs). Four backticks enable nesting code blocks within slides.

Example:
````carousel
![Image description](/absolute/path/to/image1.png)
<!-- slide -->
```python
def example():
    print("Code in carousel")
```
````

## LaTeX / Math
Artifacts render LaTeX math with KaTeX.
- **Literal `$`**: escape it as `\$` in prose (\$100), or write it bare inside backticks (`$HOME`) 

---

 never both, since backslashes inside backticks render literally. Two unescaped `$` in the same paragraph become math.

# Scratch Scripts and Files

You may find it useful to create scratch scripts or files for temporary purposes.

Examples:
- One-off scripts to process or analyze data
- Temporary data files and intermediate outputs

Store these files in the `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>/scratch/` directory. They will be persisted.

</artifacts>
<conversation_transcript>
Transcripts are located directly at `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>\.system_generated\logs/transcript.jsonl` (and `transcript_full.jsonl`).
- Start with `transcript.jsonl` (compact). When `truncated_fields` is present, read only the specific corresponding line in `transcript_full.jsonl`.
- Search subagents by grepping `invoke_subagent` in `transcript.jsonl`.
- Link conversations using `[<label>](conversation://<conversation-id>)`.

# File Format
Transcripts are in JSON Lines (JSONL) format. Each line is a single JSON object representing one "step" or action in the conversation.
Each JSON object contains fields such as:
- `step_index`: The index of the step in the trajectory.
- `source`: The source of the action (e.g., `USER_EXPLICIT`, `MODEL`, `SYSTEM`).
- `type`: The type of the step. Particular steps of interest are `USER_INPUT`, which represents a user's prompt, and `PLANNER_RESPONSE`, which represents the agent's response and tool calls.
- `status`: The status of the step (e.g., `DONE`, `ERROR`).
- `created_at`: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the step occurred.
- `content`: The text content of the step (e.g., the user's request, the model's response, or tool responses).
- `thinking`: The model's internal reasoning / chain-of-thought (for `PLANNER_RESPONSE` steps).
- `tool_calls`: An array of tool calls made in this step, including their arguments.
- `media`: An array of media (e.g. images) attached to the step, each with a `mime_type` and a `uri` referencing the media file on disk. Media bytes are not stored in the transcript; view the `uri` path to see the media.
- `truncated_fields`: An array of field names that were truncated (e.g., `["content"]`, `["thinking"]`, `["tool_calls"]`). Only present in `transcript.jsonl` when truncation occurred (never in `transcript_full.jsonl`). When present, read the corresponding line in `transcript_full.jsonl` for the complete content.

</conversation_transcript>

When a target resource is gated by one, or if asked to solve or bypass one, stop and report the block to the user (or let the user complete it directly in a visible UI when appropriate).

</guidelines>
<work_efficiently>
Every turn re-sends the whole conversation, so batch: in each turn, issue in parallel every independent search, read and edit or write you need next. Run all independent search operations at once; read all needed files (data, documents, references, source) in the same turn; read whole files within the max limit of your tool to read files, otherwise substantial ranges per read, plus the top of the file (for headers) if you may edit it; create or edit all files in one turn. In the shell, chain dependent steps with `&&` and independent checks with `;` so execution, validation, and status or diff checks happen in a single command across all affected targets; when a command fails, fix all reported errors before re-running. Never one call per turn; never repeat a search or re-read content you already know that hasn't changed. Working efficiently never means skipping checks to save turns; don't re-run passing tests or diffs without new edits.
</work_efficiently>

Artifacts are special markdown (.md) documents that you can create to present structured information to the user.
All artifacts should be written to the artifact directory: `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>`. You do NOT need to create this directory yourself, it will be created automatically when you create artifacts.

# When to Use Artifacts

**Use artifacts for:**
- Extensive reports and analysis summaries
- Persistent information you'll update over time (task lists, experiment logs)

**Don't use artifacts for:**
- Simple one-off answers or very short paragraph content - just respond directly
- Asking questions or requesting user input - just ask directly

**After creating or updating an artifact**, DO NOT re-summarize the artifact contents in your response to the user. Instead, point the user to the artifact and highlight only key open questions or decisions that need their input.


# Artifact Formatting Tips
When creating markdown artifacts, use standard markdown and GitHub Flavored Markdown formatting.

## Alerts
Use GitHub-style alerts strategically to emphasize critical information. Do not place consecutively or nest:
  > [!NOTE] Background context, implementation details, or explanations
  > [!TIP] Performance optimizations, best practices, or efficiency suggestions
  > [!IMPORTANT] Essential requirements, critical steps, or must-know information
  > [!WARNING] Breaking changes, compatibility issues, or potential problems
  > [!CAUTION] High-risk actions that could cause data loss or security vulnerabilities


## Mermaid Diagrams
Create mermaid diagrams using fenced code blocks with language `mermaid` to visualize relationships, workflows, and architectures.
- Only use supported diagram types:
  - Flowcharts / Graphs: `flowchart TD` / `flowchart LR` / `graph TD` / `graph LR`
  - Sequence Diagrams: `sequenceDiagram`
  - State Diagrams: `stateDiagram-v2` or `stateDiagram`
  - Class Diagrams: `classDiagram`
  - Entity-Relationship Diagrams: `erDiagram`
  - XY Charts: `xychart-beta`
- All other diagram types are unsupported. For schedules, timelines, or roadmaps, use directed flowcharts (`flowchart LR` / `flowchart TD`) or Markdown tables instead.
- To prevent syntax errors:
  - Quote node labels containing special characters like parentheses or brackets. For example, `id["Label (Extra Info)"]` instead of `id[Label (Extra Info)]`.
  - Avoid HTML tags in labels.

## File Links
- Link to line ranges using [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file#L123-L145) format.
- **IMPORTANT**: If you are embedding a file in an artifact and the file is NOT already in <appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>, you MUST first copy the file to the artifacts directory before embedding it. Only embed files that are located in the artifacts directory. Always use its absolute path `![caption](/absolute/path)`.
- **Use basenames for readability**: Use file basenames for the link text instead of the full path

## Carousels
Use ````carousel syntax with `<!-- slide -->` HTML comments to display related markdown snippets sequentially (before/after comparisons, UI progressions, alternative approaches, walkthroughs). Four backticks enable nesting code blocks within slides.

Example:
````carousel
![Image description](/absolute/path/to/image1.png)
<!-- slide -->
```python
def example():
    print("Code in carousel")
```
````

## LaTeX / Math
Artifacts render LaTeX math with KaTeX.
- **Literal `$`**: escape it as `\$` in prose (\$100), or write it bare inside backticks (`$HOME`) 

---

 never both, since backslashes inside backticks render literally. Two unescaped `$` in the same paragraph become math.

Examples:
- One-off scripts to process or analyze data
- Temporary data files and intermediate outputs

Store these files in the `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>/scratch/` directory. They will be persisted.

<conversation_transcript>
Transcripts are located directly at `<appDataDir>\brain\<conversation-id>\.system_generated\logs/transcript.jsonl` (and `transcript_full.jsonl`).
- Start with `transcript.jsonl` (compact). When `truncated_fields` is present, read only the specific corresponding line in `transcript_full.jsonl`.
- Search subagents by grepping `invoke_subagent` in `transcript.jsonl`.
- Link conversations using `[<label>](conversation://<conversation-id>)`.

# File Format
Transcripts are in JSON Lines (JSONL) format. Each line is a single JSON object representing one "step" or action in the conversation.
Each JSON object contains fields such as:
- `step_index`: The index of the step in the trajectory.
- `source`: The source of the action (e.g., `USER_EXPLICIT`, `MODEL`, `SYSTEM`).
- `type`: The type of the step. Particular steps of interest are `USER_INPUT`, which represents a user's prompt, and `PLANNER_RESPONSE`, which represents the agent's response and tool calls.
- `status`: The status of the step (e.g., `DONE`, `ERROR`).
- `created_at`: The ISO 8601 timestamp of when the step occurred.
- `content`: The text content of the step (e.g., the user's request, the model's response, or tool responses).
- `thinking`: The model's internal reasoning / chain-of-thought (for `PLANNER_RESPONSE` steps).
- `tool_calls`: An array of tool calls made in this step, including their arguments.
- `media`: An array of media (e.g. images) attached to the step, each with a `mime_type` and a `uri` referencing the media file on disk. Media bytes are not stored in the transcript; view the `uri` path to see the media.
- `truncated_fields`: An array of field names that were truncated (e.g., `["content"]`, `["thinking"]`, `["tool_calls"]`). Only present in `transcript.jsonl` when truncation occurred (never in `transcript_full.jsonl`). When present, read the corresponding line in `transcript_full.jsonl` for the complete content.

### Three Strategic Perspectives

* **Developer Perspective:**  
  Currently, [src/pages/about.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/about.astro) imports academic CV data (*appointments, university degrees, and academic service from `about.yml`*). We will completely decouple `/about` from these academic YAML structures. We will retain the theme's [PageJumpNav.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/components/PageJumpNav.astro) component to enable smooth in-page jumping between creative sections (`#biography`, `#philosophy`, `#themes`, `#influences`), styled with UnoCSS surface cards and responsive grid layouts.

* **Entrepreneur Perspective:**  
  This page represents the **Trust Stage** in the commercial funnel. In fiction publishing, readers do not buy books because of an author's resume or credentials; they buy because they feel connected to the author's imagination. In accordance with the blueprint's **Author-to-Reader Translation Principle** and **Hero Swap**:
  1. The author is positioned as the world-builder; the reader is the hero embarking on the journey.
  2. Raw biographical facts are translated into emotional promises (*e.g., historical archival research translates into "intricately layered worlds where every forgotten detail feels alive"*).
  3. Clear conversion bridges at the bottom direct interested readers straight to the [Books Showcase](/books) and the newsletter in [The Next Chapter](/connect).

### Three Strategic Perspectives

* **Developer Perspective:**  
  Currently, [src/pages/about.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/about.astro) imports academic CV data (*appointments, university degrees, and academic service from `about.yml`*). We will completely decouple `/about` from these academic YAML structures. We will retain the theme's [PageJumpNav.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/components/PageJumpNav.astro) component to enable smooth in-page jumping between creative sections (`#biography`, `#philosophy`, `#themes`, `#influences`), styled with UnoCSS surface cards and responsive grid layouts.

* **Entrepreneur Perspective:**  
  This page represents the **Trust Stage** in the commercial funnel. In fiction publishing, readers do not buy books because of an author's resume or credentials; they buy because they feel connected to the author's imagination. In accordance with the blueprint's **Author-to-Reader Translation Principle** and **Hero Swap**:
  1. The author is positioned as the world-builder; the reader is the hero embarking on the journey.
  2. Raw biographical facts are translated into emotional promises (*e.g., historical archival research translates into "intricately layered worlds where every forgotten detail feels alive"*).
  3. Clear conversion bridges at the bottom direct interested readers straight to the [Books Showcase](/books) and the newsletter in [The Next Chapter](/connect).

* **Learning Perspective:**  
  You will see how to repurpose an existing theme component ([PageJumpNav.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/components/PageJumpNav.astro)) without breaking its behavior. By passing an array of `{ href: "#id", label: "Title" }` objects, the sticky header navigation instantly responds to scrolling and deep links.

### Implementation Summary & Perspectives

* **Developer Perspective:**
  * **Dynamic Route:** Created [src/pages/books/[...slug].astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/books/[...slug].astro). At build time, `getStaticPaths()` queries all non-draft books and compiles dedicated static HTML sales pages:
    * `/books/the-whispering-tide/index.html`
    * `/books/shadows-of-the-sunken-spire/index.html`
    * `/books/the-clockwork-cartographer/index.html`
  * **Relational Data Joins:**
    * Automatically resolves the book's parent series via `getEntry("series", data.seriesSlug)` to render series volume info (*"The St. Jude Chronicles 

---

 Book 1"*).
    * Queries the `reviews` collection by slug (`data.bookSlug === book.id`), filtering strictly for approved, non-draft reviews.
  * **Sample Reviews Added:** Created two verified sample reviews in [src/content/reviews/](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/content/reviews/) to display reader praise.
  * **Catalog Navigation:** Updated [src/pages/books/index.astro](file:///c:/Users/Eboh/Documents/Alis-Padasian/Author-Website-Not-Book/src/pages/books/index.astro) so that clicking any book title or cover links directly into its individual detail page.

* **Entrepreneur Perspective:**  
  The conversion funnel for books is now complete:
  1. A visitor browsing the catalog or clicking an external link lands on a dedicated sales page.
  2. The page leads with the book's emotional premise (*"Some secrets are carried by the wind; others refuse to drown"*).
  3. Readers can download a free first chapter instantly or click direct purchase buttons (*Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Bookshop.org*).
  4. Curated peer reactions and press quotes reinforce buying decisions through social proof.

* **Learning Perspective:**  
  You saw how Astro's **`getStaticPaths()`** bridges dynamic parameters with static generation: rather than running a database query per visitor request on a live server, Astro generates fast, secure, SEO-optimized HTML files for each book ahead of time during `pnpm build`.

  { href: "#biography", label: "Biography" },

];

    description: "Flawed protagonists caught between duty, ambition, and personal survival in unforgiving environments.",

];

  "Maritime Folklore, Forgotten Wrecks & Archival Maps",
  "Atmospheric Speculative Fiction & Alternate Realities",
  "Architectural Ruins & Coastal Micro-Histories",
];

              <span class="i-mdi:book-open-variant text-xs" aria-hidden="true" />
              The Reader's Journey
            </span>
            <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
              You are the explorer. The story is your landscape.
            </h3>
            <p class="text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
              "I believe a fiction author

---

s primary responsibility is not to preach solutions or present personal credentials, but to construct a world so rich in texture and consequence that you lose track of time inside it. Every mystery is designed as a labyrinth; every character is built with contradictions you recognize in yourself."
            </p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <!-- Section 3: Recurring Themes -->
      <section id="themes" class="content-section scroll-mt-24 space-y-6" aria-labelledby="themes-heading">
        <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-3 dark:border-ink-700">
          <h2 id="themes-heading" class="section-heading text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            Recurring Themes & Motifs
          </h2>
        </header>

        <div class="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
          {creativeThemes.map((theme) => (
            <div class="surface-card rounded-xl border border-paper-300/80 p-5 dark:border-ink-700 space-y-2.5">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class={`${theme.icon} text-accent-600 dark:text-accent-400 text-lg`} aria-hidden="true" />
                <h3 class="font-bold text-base text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">{theme.title}</h3>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-600 dark:text-paper-300">
                {theme.description}
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Section 4: Influences -->
      <section id="influences" class="content-section scroll-mt-24 space-y-6" aria-labelledby="influences-heading">
        <header class="border-b border-paper-300/90 pb-3 dark:border-ink-700">
          <h2 id="influences-heading" class="section-heading text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">
            Creative Influences & World-Building Roots
          </h2>
        </header>

        <div class="surface-card rounded-xl border border-paper-300/80 p-6 dark:border-ink-700">
          <ul class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {influences.map((inf) => (
              <li class="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm text-ink-700 dark:text-paper-300">
                <span class="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent-500 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <span>{inf}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Conversion Bridge to Action & Return -->
      <section class="border-t border-paper-300/90 pt-8 dark:border-ink-700">
        <div class="rounded-2xl border border-paper-300/90 bg-white/60 p-6 dark:border-ink-700 dark:bg-ink-900/40 sm:p-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div class="space-y-1">
            <h3 class="text-lg font-bold text-ink-950 dark:text-paper-50">Ready to enter these worlds?</h3>
            <p class="text-sm text-ink-600 dark:text-paper-400">Discover current releases or join the reader community for release bulletins.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 shrink-0">
            <a
              href="/books"
              class="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-accent-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-800 dark:bg-accent-600 dark:hover:bg-accent-500 no-underline"
            >
              <span>Explore Books</span>
              <span class="i-mdi:arrow-right text-sm" aria-hidden="true" />
            </a>
            <a
              href="/connect"
              class="action-link inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-paper-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-paper-100 dark:border-ink-700 dark:text-paper-100"
            >
              <span>The Next Chapter</span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</Layout>
```
